item.title: Osync: Self-Hosted End-to-End Encrypted Sync for Obsidian
item.description: Osync syncs Obsidian vaults in real time through a self-hosted Docker server using local AES-256-GCM encryption, Argon2id key derivation, and per-device filters.

item.title: Building a Second Brain with Claude Code and Obsidian
item.description: Connect Claude Code to a local Obsidian vault using CLAUDE.md, four-folder project layouts, and reusable skills to build a portable knowledge base.
